findings.description: The locked loom rows have no positive server-side decision line. The Bukkit event logs useBlock=ALLOW and cancelled=false, and NativeLandmarkActions logs nothing when it denies. The denial is shown only by the absence of an OpenScreen packet or INVENTORY_OPEN boundary plus the client overlay. The verdict is reproducible, but the evidence is indirect.

The client-mod path is stored with its Cyrillic folder name mojibake-encoded (UTF-8 bytes read as cp1251), so a third party cannot open it as written. I located the real file and its hash matches. This is a record defect only.
